subject_need: Enable quality intent discovery before QIF artifact generation
alternative_solutions: Create a separate QIF Discovery Layer design with discovery patterns, dynamic flow, and traceability to QIF generation.
Extend existing Discovery Session schema only, without a separate conceptual layer.
Create a fixed quality category checklist as a guided questionnaire.
non_solution_options: Ask users to manually author Quality Intents without discovery support.
Treat common quality categories such as performance, security, and availability as default coverage requirements.
defer_options: Wait for a v0.3 pilot before defining Discovery Patterns.
stop_options: Do not implement a fixed category checklist as the discovery mechanism.
Do not start v0.3 schema implementation until the Discovery Layer boundary is accepted.
